rules.boundary: fresh public sorting call including initialization/core/output recovery, batch loop and output append inside; expected comparison, gc.collect, serialization and persistence outside

calibration.rule: per input choose first common B where both backend medians reach target; test candidates ascending, alternating backend first; if none, stop and revise protocol before formal measurements
calibration.scope: separate calibration identity; no calibration observations in performance table

rules.clock: perf_counter_ns; record implementation/resolution and 1000 consecutive read deltas
rules.environment: freeze commit, all source hashes, exact input/config hashes, Python executable/version/flags, OS/architecture, CPU/cores/RAM, power state, GC and clock; single idle host, no concurrent checked validation or development loads
gates: common qualification archive independently validated against producing source/config
calibration complete and per-input B frozen before any formal sample
manual representation/locality/cost claims, assumptions and open obligations reviewed; efficient-backend minimum not certified by this protocol
formal runner/validator tested and exact measurement-source revision frozen; source/config changes require affected requalification
rules.gc: enabled with recorded default thresholds; gc.collect outside each batch; do not disable cyclic GC
rules.historical: rollback 60-input/3600-row results and development pilot remain separate
rules.input_set: entire frozen selected set after every selected case passes both backends; report cell deficits, never filter legal backend failures

order.backend_first: alternate by shuffled case index plus round; 10 first positions per backend over 20 sample rounds

statistics.comparison: ratio of tree and list per-input medians; report all inputs and descriptive strata distributions, no independent-sample inference for mirrors
statistics.exclusions: none for slow or extreme durations; failed/timeout runs remain failed, no silent trimming/retry
statistics.per_input: median and IQR of 20 per-call batch observations; linear quantiles at .25/.75 (R7)
statistics.unit: timing batch; calls within a batch are not independent samples
